name: dsa-visualizer
description: Shows what each line of a C# solution costs in time and memory, and plots how that cost grows with input size.

commands.title: DSA Visualizer: Compare With Another Solution...

dsaViz.enginePath.markdownDescription: Path to the built `DsaViz.Engine` executable. Left empty, the extension looks for it under `engine/DsaViz.Engine/bin/Debug/net8.0/` in the open workspace.

dsaViz.sizes.markdownDescription: Input sizes to measure. Leave empty to let the engine choose: it starts at `10, 25, 50, 100, 250, 500, 1000` and drops to small sizes on its own when an algorithm is too expensive for them — which is the only way an exponential solution gets a curve at all.

dsaViz.timeoutSeconds.description: Longest a whole measurement may take before the engine is stopped. This is what guarantees the editor never waits forever.

dsaViz.budget.description: Maximum statements a single run may execute before it is stopped. This is what keeps a runaway loop from hanging the editor.
